items.summary: EMPLOYMENT BULLETIN BOARD About The Nation Bigstone Cree Nation (BCN) is comprised of three communities. Calling Lake, Chipewyan Lake, and Wabasca all located in present day Alberta. BCN was signed into the "Treaty 8" agreement in 1899 and was provided with funds along with reserve lands to govern for growth of its membership. As of the 2016 census, BCN membership rounds off to five-thousand members; both on and off.
